title: Wall Tiles in Coimbatore | Elite Balaji
description: Ceramic and vitrified wall tiles, marble-look large formats and stone cladding for bathrooms, kitchens and feature walls, from our Karamadai showroom.
intro: Wall tiles are lighter and more decorative than floor tiles, and they are where a bathroom or kitchen gets its character. We stock glazed ceramic wall tiles, marble-look large formats for feature walls, and natural stone cladding when you want real material on the wall.
Tell us the wall size and the look you are after and we will show you what is in the showroom this week.

choose.title: Wall tiles are not floor tiles
choose.detail: Wall tiles are thinner and glazed for looks, not for foot traffic. Ask us before using a wall tile on a floor.

choose.title: One feature wall, one plain
choose.detail: A patterned or marble-look wall works best when the other walls stay quiet.

choose.title: Check the batch
choose.detail: Shade varies between production batches, so buy the full wall in one lot with a little extra.

faq.q: Can I use the same tile on the wall and the floor?
faq.a: Some vitrified tiles work on both; glazed ceramic wall tiles do not belong on a floor. We will tell you which is which for the tile you like.

faq.q: Do you supply marble-look tiles for feature walls?
faq.a: Yes, the Mozzato Endless 600 × 1200 mm range is marble-look and works well on walls, along with real marble and granite cladding.
